latest_release.name: v0.40.15
latest_release.body:
## MiMo V2.6

Xiaomi MiMo's [mimo-v2.6](https://ollama.com/library/mimo-v2.6), a 9B model built for code and agent workflows, is now supported in Ollama.

```sh
ollama run mimo-v2.6
```

## AutoTrust decision models

[AutoTrust](https://ollama.com/library/autotrust-jev) decision models read text and return choices, yes or no probabilities, and ratings for the questions you supply. The family includes 9b, 35b, and 27b-vl sizes — the 35b and 27b-vl sizes can also read images.

```sh
ollama run autotrust-jev "A customer says their card was charged twice." --ask "Is this a billing issue?"
```

Note: autotrust-jev is supported on Apple silicon in this release.

## What's Changed

 - ollama launch now supports Kimi Code CLI — the successor to kimi-cli — and offers to migrate existing kimi-cli setups
 - ollama launch now fills in Pi's model list automatically so models can be picked inside Pi, and Claude Desktop's model
   picker shows Ollama's actual model names
 - Recurrent and vision GGUF models can now serve more than one request at a time
 - Qwen3 and Qwen3.5 models using long-context (YaRN) scaling
 - Running ollama with no arguments opens the welcome launcher

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ollama/ollama/compare/v0.40.14...v0.40.15

Access the latest releases locally or in the cloud with complete privacy. ## Download ### macOS ```shell curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh ``` or [download manually](https://ollama.com/download/Ollama.dmg) ### Windows ```shell irm https://ollama.com/install.ps1 | iex ``` or [download manually](https://ollama.com/download/OllamaSetup.exe) ### Linux ```shell curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh ``` [Manual install instructions](https://docs.ollama.com/linux#manual-install) ### Docker The official [Ollama Docker image](https://hub.docker.com/r/ollama/ollama) `ollama/ollama` is available on Docker Hub. ### Libraries - [ollama-python](https://github.com/ollama/ollama-python) - [ollama-js](https://github.com/ollama/ollama-js) ### Community - [Discord](https://discord.gg/ollama) - [𝕏 (Twitter)](https://x.com/ollama) - [Reddit](https://reddit.com/r/ollama) ## Get started ``` ollama ``` You'll be prompted to run a model or connect Ollama to your existing agents or applications such as `Claude Code`, `OpenClaw`, `OpenCode` , `Codex`, `Copilot`, and more. ### Coding To launch a specific integration: ``` ollama launch claude ``` Supported integrations include [Claude Code](https://docs.ollama.com/integrations/claude-code), [Codex](https://docs.ollama.com/integrations/codex), [Copilot CLI](https://docs.ollama.com/integrations/copilot-cli), [DeepSeek Harness](https://docs.ollama.com/integrations/deepseek-harness), [Droid](https://docs.ollama.com/integrations/droid), and [OpenCode](https://docs.ollama.com/integrations/opencode). ### AI assistant Use [OpenClaw](https://docs.ollama.com/integrations/openclaw) to turn Ollama into a personal AI assistant across WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, and more: ``` ollama launch openclaw ``` ### Chat with a model Run and chat with [Gemma 4](https://ollama.com/library/gemma4): ``` ollama run gemma4 ``` See [ollama.com/library](https://ollama.com/library) for the full list.
